name: AIReg-Bench
description:
AIReg-Bench Dataset
	

AIReg-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark dataset for evaluating the compliance of AI systems with the EU AI Act.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset is organized as follows:

documentation/: This folder contains 300 .txt files, each representing a unique excerpt of (AI-generated) AI system technical documentation. The documentation is organized based on the articles of the EU AI Act it pertains to, the intended use of the AI system, the details of the AI… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/camlsys/AIReg-Bench.
reputation: An emerging benchmark focused on regulatory compliance with the EU AI Act, used mainly by researchers working on AI governance and compliance tooling.
